title: Sepuluh Lagi, Abang
genre: KL rempit club (Malay gabber-breakcore with kompang)
subject: a man doing knee physiotherapy after ligament surgery at a hospital in Klang, whose physiotherapist counts his leg raises like a club MC until he can climb a step unaided
caption: KL rempit club music, Malay gabber-breakcore. Distorted gabber kick, chopped amen breaks, live kompang frame-drum patterns layered over the kick, hoover synth stabs, a reedy serunai-like lead synth melody. Raw overdriven club mix with saturated kicks. Female coach voice shouting call lines and a tired male patient answering, chanted unison hooks in a clear speaking range. 180 BPM, A minor. Loud, sweaty, triumphant and comic. No autotune, no trap, no pop ballad section, no dubstep wobble, no rap verses.
lyrics:
[Intro - kompang and hoover stabs, kick builds]

[Verse 1]
Bilik fisio tingkat tiga
Lutut baru dijahit
Kak Ros tepuk tangan kuat
Angkat kaki, jangan lambat

[Pre-Chorus]
Satu, dua, tiga, empat
Peluh dah turun ke mata

[Chorus]
Sepuluh lagi, abang
Angkat, turun, tahan
Sepuluh lagi, abang
Lutut abang boleh tahan

[Verse 2]
Minggu ketiga, tongkat hilang
Satu anak tangga macam gunung
Kak Ros jerit macam DJ
Naik, naik, jangan tunduk

[Chorus]
Sepuluh lagi, abang
Angkat, turun, tahan
Satu tangga, abang naik
Kak Ros pun menangis sikit

[Outro - kompang alone, final kick hit]
